questions.question:
An astronomical refractive telescope has an objective of focal length \(20~\text{m}\) and an eyepiece of focal length \(2~\text{cm}\).
(A)The length of the telescope tube is \(20.02~\text{m}\).
(B)The magnification is \(1000\).
(C)The image formed is inverted.
(D)An objective of a larger aperture will increase the brightness and reduce chromatic aberration of the image.
Choose the correct option from the given ones:
1.(A) and (D) only
2.(A), (B) and (C) only
3.(B) and (D) only
4.(C) and (D) only
questions.explanation:
Hint:\(m= \dfrac{f_o}{f_e}\) Step: Analyse each statement one by one. Given: The focal length ofobjective\(20~\text{m}\), the focal length of the eyepiece\(2~\text{cm}\) The tube length of the telescope is approximately the sum of the focal lengths of the objective and the eyepiece i.e.,\(f_o +f_e = 20+0.02= 20.02~\text{m}\). So, statement (A) is correct. The magnification \(m\) of an astronomical telescope is given by the ratio of the focal length of the objective to the focal length of the eyepiece i.e.,\(m= \dfrac{f_o}{f_e}\) \(\Rightarrow m = \frac{20}{0.02}= 1000\) So, statement (B) is correct. In a typical astronomical telescope, the image formed by the objective is inverted (upside down) because of the nature of the optical system. So, statement(C) is correct. A larger aperture increases the amount of light entering the telescope, which increases the brightness of the image. However, it does not necessarily reduce chromatic aberration. So, statement (D) is incorrect. Therefore, the correct statements are(A),(B) and (C)only. Hence, option (2) is the correct answer.
